blocks.zh: Preface | 序言
blocks.en: Preface

blocks.zh: Purpose and legal context of the GAMP IT Infrastructure Guide · 指南目的與法律聲明
blocks.en: Purpose and legal context of the GAMP IT Infrastructure Guide

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務解讀
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Interpretation

blocks.zh: 這份指南是什麼？
blocks.en: What is this guide?

blocks.zh: GAMP IT基礎設施指南是GAMP 4的補充文件，專門聚焦於支撐GxP應用程式的底層IT環境——包含伺服器、網路、作業系統、資料庫平台等。
blocks.en: The GAMP IT Infrastructure Guide is a supplement to GAMP 4. It focuses on the underlying IT environment that supports GxP applications, including servers, networks, operating systems and database platforms.

blocks.zh: 在製藥CDMO中，IT基礎設施是所有數位化製造系統的地基。MES出問題了？先查OS patch。LIMS資料遺失？先看backup策略是否合規。這本指南就是管控這個「地基層」的標準。
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical CDMO, IT infrastructure is the foundation of every digital manufacturing system. MES has a problem? Check the OS patches first. LIMS lost data? Check whether the backup strategy is compliant. This guide is the standard for controlling that "foundation layer".

blocks.zh: 建築比喻
blocks.en: Building analogy

blocks.zh: 應用程式（MES、LIMS、QMS）是建築物，IT基礎設施是地基和鋼筋。即使建築物本身設計完美，若地基不穩定，整棟建築都有崩塌風險。這份指南確保「地基」本身符合GxP要求。
blocks.en: Applications (MES, LIMS, QMS) are the building; IT infrastructure is the foundation and the reinforcing steel. Even if the building itself is perfectly designed, an unstable foundation puts the whole structure at risk of collapse. This guide ensures that the "foundation" itself meets GxP requirements.

blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.en: Why does the IT Infrastructure Guide need to be a "supplement" to GAMP 4 rather than a stand-alone document?

blocks.zh: CDMO的IT部門和QA部門在閱讀此指南時，各自的關注重點會有哪些不同？
blocks.en: When the IT department and the QA department of a CDMO read this guide, how do their points of focus differ?

blocks.zh: 「法規當局不保證接受」這個免責聲明對你的法規策略有何實際影響？
blocks.en: What practical effect does the disclaimer that "regulatory authorities do not guarantee acceptance" have on your regulatory strategy?

blocks.zh: Overview | 概述
blocks.en: Overview

blocks.zh: Why IT Infrastructure control matters for GxP compliance · 為何IT基礎設施管控對GxP合規至關重要
blocks.en: Why IT Infrastructure control matters for GxP compliance

blocks.zh: 核心警示：連鎖失效風險
blocks.en: Key warning: cascading failure risk

blocks.zh: 指南明確說明：若IT基礎設施失控，整個廠區或地區的作業可能停擺。在CDMO環境中，這意味著：
blocks.en: The guide states clearly that if IT infrastructure is not under control, operations across an entire site or region may come to a halt. In a CDMO environment, this means:

blocks.zh: MES停機 → 批次記錄無法建立 → 生產暫停
blocks.en: MES down → batch records cannot be created → production stops

blocks.zh: LIMS無法存取 → 放行檢驗無法完成 → 批次卡關
blocks.en: LIMS inaccessible → release testing cannot be completed → batch is held up

blocks.zh: DCS/SCADA失效 → 製程監控中斷 → FDA 21 CFR Part 11 數據完整性疑慮
blocks.en: DCS/SCADA failure → process monitoring is interrupted → FDA 21 CFR Part 11 data integrity concerns

blocks.zh: CDMO的IT基礎設施涵蓋範圍
blocks.en: Scope of CDMO IT infrastructure

blocks.zh: Server infrastructure：MES、LIMS、QMS的主機伺服器
blocks.en: Server infrastructure: host servers for MES, LIMS and QMS

blocks.zh: Network：廠區內部網路、隔離的GxP網段
blocks.en: Network: the site internal network and isolated GxP network segments

blocks.zh: OS/Database：Windows Server、Oracle DB等
blocks.en: OS/Database: Windows Server, Oracle DB, etc.

blocks.zh: Virtualization：VMware環境（若使用）
blocks.en: Virtualization: VMware environment (if used)

blocks.zh: Storage/Backup：批次記錄的長期保存系統
blocks.en: Storage/Backup: long-term retention systems for batch records

blocks.zh: 關鍵定義：IT Infrastructure
blocks.en: Key definition: IT Infrastructure

blocks.zh: IT Infrastructure（IT基礎設施） = 平台（Platforms）+ 服務（Services）+ 相關流程、程序、人員的集合體。
blocks.en: IT Infrastructure = the collection of platforms + services + the related processes, procedures and personnel.

blocks.zh: 這個定義很重要：IT基礎設施不只是硬體，還包含圍繞它運作的流程和負責的人員。
blocks.en: This definition is important: IT infrastructure is not just hardware. It also includes the processes that operate around it and the people responsible for it.

blocks.zh: 列出你廠區中三個依賴IT基礎設施的GxP應用程式，並描述若底層伺服器發生故障的影響。
blocks.en: List three GxP applications at your site that depend on IT infrastructure, and describe the impact if the underlying server fails.

blocks.zh: 「可示範的控制狀態（demonstrable state of control）」在法規稽查時意味著需要準備哪些文件？
blocks.en: What documents need to be prepared to show a "demonstrable state of control" during a regulatory inspection?

blocks.zh: 為何備份（Backup）和災難復原（Disaster Recovery）被列為IT基礎設施的關鍵考量？
blocks.en: Why are backup and disaster recovery listed as key considerations for IT infrastructure?

blocks.zh: Purpose | 目的
blocks.en: Purpose

blocks.zh: What this Guide aims to achieve · 本指南的目標
blocks.en: What this Guide aims to achieve

blocks.zh: 三個核心動作：Identify → Qualify → Control
blocks.en: Three core actions: Identify → Qualify → Control

blocks.zh: 這三個動詞定義了整個IT基礎設施合規管理的生命週期：
blocks.en: These three verbs define the whole lifecycle of IT infrastructure compliance management:

blocks.zh: Identify（識別）：哪些IT元件支撐GxP應用程式？哪些在GxP範圍內？
blocks.en: Identify: Which IT components support GxP applications? Which are within GxP scope?

blocks.zh: Qualify（資格確認）：執行IQ/OQ，確認元件能滿足規格要求
blocks.en: Qualify: Perform IQ/OQ to confirm that the components meet their specifications

blocks.zh: Control（管控）：持續的變更管理、組態管理、定期審查
blocks.en: Control: Ongoing change management, configuration management and periodic review

blocks.zh: 可縮放資格確認框架（Scaleable Qualification Framework）
blocks.en: Scaleable Qualification Framework

blocks.zh: 框架可依據以下因素調整規模：
blocks.en: The framework can be scaled according to the following factors:

blocks.zh: 平台的GxP衝擊程度（風險驅動）
blocks.en: The GxP impact of the platform (risk-driven)

blocks.zh: 公司規模（小型CDMO vs 跨國大廠）
blocks.en: Company size (small CDMO vs multinational manufacturer)

blocks.zh: 平台類型（獨立伺服器 vs 虛擬化環境 vs 雲端）
blocks.en: Platform type (stand-alone server vs virtualized environment vs cloud)

blocks.zh: 這表示框架不是一刀切的——你可以根據風險評估調整資格確認的深度和廣度。
blocks.en: This means the framework is not one-size-fits-all: you can adjust the depth and breadth of qualification based on risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 「可縮放框架」對資源有限的小型CDMO意味著什麼？你會如何優先排序？
blocks.en: What does a "scaleable framework" mean for a small CDMO with limited resources? How would you prioritize?

blocks.zh: IT供應商（如外包的雲端服務商）閱讀此指南後，需要承擔哪些責任？
blocks.en: What responsibilities does an IT supplier (such as an outsourced cloud service provider) take on after reading this guide?

blocks.zh: 如何確保你廠區的IT術語與GAMP指南一致，避免稽查時的溝通誤差？
blocks.en: How do you make sure the IT terminology at your site is consistent with the GAMP guide, so that communication errors are avoided during inspections?

blocks.zh: Scope | 適用範圍
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: What is included and excluded from this Guide · 本指南的涵蓋範圍與排除項目
blocks.en: What is included and excluded from this Guide

blocks.zh: 適用範圍清單（CDMO視角）
blocks.en: Scope list (CDMO perspective)

blocks.zh: 涵蓋（In Scope）：
blocks.en: In Scope:

blocks.zh: 支撐MES、LIMS、QMS、DCS/SCADA的伺服器和網路
blocks.en: Servers and networks that support MES, LIMS, QMS and DCS/SCADA

blocks.zh: GxP資料庫平台（Oracle、SQL Server）
blocks.en: GxP database platforms (Oracle, SQL Server)

blocks.zh: 作業系統（Windows Server、Linux）
blocks.en: Operating systems (Windows Server, Linux)

blocks.zh: 虛擬化平台（VMware等）
blocks.en: Virtualization platforms (VMware, etc.)

blocks.zh: 儲存和備份系統
blocks.en: Storage and backup systems

blocks.zh: 既有平台（legacy）和新建平台
blocks.en: Existing (legacy) platforms and new platforms

blocks.zh: 排除（Out of Scope）：
blocks.en: Out of Scope:

blocks.zh: MES、LIMS等應用程式本身的驗證（由GAMP 4規範）
blocks.en: Validation of applications such as MES and LIMS themselves (covered by GAMP 4)

blocks.zh: 業務連續性計畫（BCP）中的替代作業程序
blocks.en: Alternative working procedures within the Business Continuity Plan (BCP)

blocks.zh: 新平台 vs 既有平台的實務差異
blocks.en: Practical differences between new and existing platforms

blocks.zh: 新平台：從需求規格開始，完整走過IQ/OQ流程，文件較完整
blocks.en: New platforms: Start from the requirements specification and go through the full IQ/OQ process; documentation is more complete

blocks.zh: 既有平台（Legacy）：需進行回溯性資格確認（retrospective qualification），評估現況是否符合要求，補齊文件落差
blocks.en: Existing platforms (Legacy): Require retrospective qualification to assess whether the current state meets requirements and to fill documentation gaps

blocks.zh: 許多CDMO的IT基礎設施在指南出版之前已存在，因此「既有平台」的合規路徑尤其重要。
blocks.en: Many CDMO IT infrastructures existed before the guide was published, so the compliance path for "existing platforms" is especially important.

blocks.zh: 你廠區的哪些IT系統屬於GMP範圍？哪些屬於GLP？哪些兩者都有？
blocks.en: Which IT systems at your site are within GMP scope? Which are within GLP scope? Which are in both?

blocks.zh: 若廠區同時支援GMP和非GMP客戶，你會如何在同一IT基礎設施中進行GxP邊界劃分？
blocks.en: If your site supports both GMP and non-GMP customers, how would you define the GxP boundary within the same IT infrastructure?

blocks.zh: 業務連續性計畫（BCP）被排除在外，但IT災難復原（DR）在範圍內——兩者的界線在哪裡？
blocks.en: The BCP is excluded, but IT disaster recovery (DR) is in scope. Where is the boundary between the two?

blocks.zh: Benefits | 效益
blocks.en: Benefits

blocks.zh: Advantages of the horizontal platform-based approach · 水平式平台導向方法的優勢
blocks.en: Advantages of the horizontal platform-based approach

blocks.zh: 垂直 vs 水平方法：超市收銀機比喻
blocks.en: Horizontal vs vertical approach: the supermarket checkout analogy

blocks.zh: 垂直方法（低效）：每台收銀機都獨立稽查一次POS系統的伺服器、網路、OS——但同一台伺服器可能服務20台收銀機，結果做了20次重複的工作。
blocks.en: Vertical approach (inefficient): Each checkout is audited separately, including the POS system's server, network and OS. But one server may serve 20 checkouts, so the same work is repeated 20 times.

blocks.zh: 水平方法（高效）：先資格確認「收銀機共用平台」一次，後續每台收銀機的應用程式驗證只需確認「平台已合規」即可。
blocks.en: Horizontal approach (efficient): First qualify the "shared checkout platform" once. Validation of each checkout application then only needs to confirm that "the platform is already compliant".

blocks.zh: 在CDMO中，若一台伺服器同時支援MES和LIMS，水平方法讓伺服器只需資格確認一次。
blocks.en: In a CDMO, if one server supports both MES and LIMS, the horizontal approach means the server only needs to be qualified once.

blocks.zh: 為何平台的殘留風險較低？
blocks.en: Why is the residual risk of platforms lower?

blocks.zh: 平台（OS、資料庫）設計目的是保護資料完整性，而應用程式設計目的是建立和操作資料。應用程式更可能引入業務邏輯錯誤，導致數據問題；平台的風險通常是可用性（availability）而非數據正確性。
blocks.en: Platforms (OS, database) are designed to protect data integrity, whereas applications are designed to create and operate on data. Applications are more likely to introduce business logic errors that lead to data problems; the risk of a platform is usually availability rather than data correctness.

blocks.zh: 水平方法的CDMO實踐
blocks.en: Horizontal approach in CDMO practice

blocks.zh: Standard server build：建立標準化伺服器配置包，資格確認一次後可複製部署
blocks.en: Standard server build: Create a standardized server configuration package that can be replicated and deployed after being qualified once

blocks.zh: Platform qualification package：一份平台資格確認文件，多個應用程式共用
blocks.en: Platform qualification package: One platform qualification document shared by multiple applications

blocks.zh: One audit for the platform：稽查人員只需審查一次平台文件，不需重複查每個應用程式的底層基礎設施
blocks.en: One audit for the platform: The auditor only needs to review the platform documentation once, rather than checking the underlying infrastructure of every application

blocks.zh: 若你的廠區有5個GxP應用程式都運行在同一台虛擬化伺服器上，水平方法能節省多少資格確認工作量？
blocks.en: If your site has five GxP applications running on the same virtualized server, how much qualification effort would the horizontal approach save?

blocks.zh: 「標準化元件有自我錯誤偵測功能」這個特性如何支持較輕量的資格確認策略？
blocks.en: How does the characteristic that "standardized components have self-error-detection capability" support a lighter qualification strategy?

blocks.zh: 水平方法在哪些情況下可能不適用（例如：特殊配置或高度客製化環境）？
blocks.en: In what situations might the horizontal approach not be applicable (for example, special configurations or highly customized environments)?

blocks.zh: Objectives | 指導原則
blocks.en: Objectives

blocks.zh: GAMP Council guiding principles for this Guide · GAMP委員會制定本指南的指導原則
blocks.en: GAMP Council guiding principles for this Guide

blocks.zh: GxP IT管控的根本目的
blocks.en: The fundamental purpose of GxP IT control

blocks.zh: 指南開宗明義：IT管控的目標是保護產品品質和公眾健康，而非為了技術本身。這個框架讓你在回答稽查員問題時有明確的論述基礎：「我們的每一項IT控制措施都是為了確保GxP記錄的完整性和系統的可靠性，最終保護患者安全。」
blocks.en: The guide states at the outset that the goal of IT control is to protect product quality and public health, not technology for its own sake. This framework gives you a clear basis for answering an inspector's questions: "Every IT control we have is there to ensure the integrity of GxP records and the reliability of the system, and ultimately to protect patient safety."

blocks.zh: Change Control中的特殊挑戰：Patch Management
blocks.en: A special challenge in Change Control: Patch Management

blocks.zh: 指南特別提到病毒簽名更新和安全性補丁的變更控制——這在GxP環境中是高頻率的實際挑戰：
blocks.en: The guide specifically mentions change control for virus signature updates and security patches. In a GxP environment this is a frequent, real-world challenge:

blocks.zh: 安全補丁需要快速部署（資安要求）
blocks.en: Security patches need to be deployed quickly (information security requirement)

blocks.zh: 但每次OS patch都可能影響已驗證的應用程式（GxP要求）
blocks.en: But every OS patch may affect validated applications (GxP requirement)

blocks.zh: 解決方案：建立patch管理SOP，包含影響評估和快速回歸測試程序
blocks.en: Solution: Establish a patch management SOP that includes impact assessment and a rapid regression testing procedure

blocks.zh: ISO17799（現為ISO 27001）在GxP中的應用
blocks.en: Applying ISO17799 (now ISO 27001) in GxP

blocks.zh: 資訊安全標準ISO17799（現已演進為ISO 27001）與GxP的IT安全要求高度重疊，尤其在：訪問控制、審計日誌、事件管理、備份程序等方面。許多CDMO同時追求ISO 27001認證和GxP合規，兩者可以共用大量管控措施。
blocks.en: The information security standard ISO17799 (now evolved into ISO 27001) overlaps heavily with GxP IT security requirements, especially in access control, audit logs, incident management and backup procedures. Many CDMOs pursue ISO 27001 certification and GxP compliance at the same time, and the two can share a large number of controls.

blocks.zh: 當資安部門要求緊急部署安全補丁，但QA要求先進行影響評估——你如何設計一個能同時滿足兩方的流程？
blocks.en: When the information security department requires urgent deployment of a security patch but QA requires an impact assessment first, how would you design a process that satisfies both?

blocks.zh: ISO27001認證和GxP IT合規有哪些重疊之處？在CDMO中如何整合兩套要求？
blocks.en: Where do ISO 27001 certification and GxP IT compliance overlap? How would you integrate the two sets of requirements in a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 「實用且高效（practical and efficient）」的目標如何影響你在小型CDMO中設計合規程序的方式？
blocks.en: How does the goal of being "practical and efficient" affect the way you design compliance procedures in a small CDMO?

blocks.zh: Key Concepts | 核心概念
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Horizontal approach, key terminology, qualification vs validation · 水平方法、關鍵術語、資格確認vs驗證
blocks.en: Horizontal approach, key terminology, qualification vs validation

blocks.zh: Platform vs Application 層次架構圖
blocks.en: Platform vs Application layer diagram

blocks.zh: ↕ 驗證（Validation）— 應用程式層
blocks.en: ↕ Validation: Application layer

blocks.zh: ↕ 資格確認（Qualification）— 平台層
blocks.en: ↕ Qualification: Platform layer

blocks.zh: 平台（綠色）= 本指南範圍 | 應用程式（紅色）= GAMP 4範圍
blocks.en: Platform (green) = scope of this guide | Application (red) = scope of GAMP 4

blocks.zh: Building Blocks（積木）概念
blocks.en: The "Building Blocks" concept

blocks.zh: 標準化、可重用的已資格確認平台元件稱為「building blocks」。
blocks.en: Standardized, reusable, qualified platform components are called "building blocks".

blocks.zh: 實務範例：若你建立了一套標準Windows Server配置並完成資格確認，下次部署相同配置的伺服器時，只需確認配置一致，不需重新從頭做完整IQ/OQ——大幅降低重複工作。
blocks.en: Practical example: If you have built and qualified a standard Windows Server configuration, the next time you deploy a server with the same configuration you only need to confirm that the configuration is identical. You do not need to repeat the full IQ/OQ from scratch, which greatly reduces duplicated work.

blocks.zh: Qualification vs Validation：關鍵區別
blocks.en: Qualification vs Validation: the key difference

blocks.zh: Qualification（資格確認）適用於IT基礎設施平台（伺服器、網路、OS、資料庫）。
blocks.en: Qualification applies to IT infrastructure platforms (servers, networks, OS, databases).

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）適用於運行在基礎設施上的GxP應用程式（MES、LIMS）。
blocks.en: Validation applies to GxP applications (MES, LIMS) that run on the infrastructure.

blocks.zh: 稽查員問你的LIMS伺服器有沒有「驗證」時，正確答案是：「伺服器已完成資格確認（qualified），LIMS應用程式已完成驗證（validated）。」
blocks.en: When an auditor asks whether your LIMS server has been "validated", the correct answer is: "The server has been qualified, and the LIMS application has been validated."

blocks.zh: 你廠區的Oracle資料庫伺服器同時支援LIMS和QMS，請說明如何用「building block」方法進行資格確認。
blocks.en: Your Oracle database server supports both LIMS and QMS. Explain how you would qualify it using the "building block" approach.

blocks.zh: 若MES供應商發布新版本，根據水平方法，IT基礎設施平台需要重新資格確認嗎？
blocks.en: If the MES supplier releases a new version, does the IT infrastructure platform need to be requalified under the horizontal approach?

blocks.zh: SLA（服務水準協議）在IT基礎設施的GxP合規中扮演什麼角色？應包含哪些關鍵要求？
blocks.en: What role does an SLA (service level agreement) play in GxP compliance of IT infrastructure? What key requirements should it include?

blocks.zh: GxP IT System Classification | GxP IT系統分類表
blocks.en: GxP IT System Classification

blocks.zh: Which systems are GxP-impacted in a pharma CDMO · 製藥CDMO中哪些系統屬於GxP範圍
blocks.en: Which systems are GxP-impacted in a pharma CDMO

blocks.zh: GxP衝擊判斷標準
blocks.en: Criteria for GxP impact

blocks.zh: 一個IT系統是否屬於GxP範圍，取決於它是否直接影響以下任一項：
blocks.en: Whether an IT system is within GxP scope depends on whether it directly affects any of the following:

blocks.zh: 產品品質：製程參數、批次記錄、放行檢驗
blocks.en: Product quality: process parameters, batch records, release testing

blocks.zh: 患者安全：無菌保證、效價記錄
blocks.en: Patient safety: sterility assurance, potency records

blocks.zh: 記錄完整性：資料可被修改、刪除，或無法追溯
blocks.en: Record integrity: data that can be modified or deleted, or cannot be traced

blocks.zh: OT網路 vs IT網路的分離
blocks.en: Separation of OT and IT networks

blocks.zh: 在無菌製藥CDMO中，DCS/SCADA等製程控制系統（OT）的網路通常需要與一般IT網路實體隔離或邏輯隔離：
blocks.en: In a sterile pharmaceutical CDMO, the network of process control systems (OT) such as DCS/SCADA usually needs to be physically or logically segregated from the general IT network:

blocks.zh: OT網路（製程控制層）：高可用性要求，不容許隨意patch
blocks.en: OT network (process control layer): high availability requirement; arbitrary patching is not allowed

blocks.zh: IT網路（辦公室/業務層）：標準IT管理
blocks.en: IT network (office/business layer): standard IT management

blocks.zh: DMZ（非軍事區）：兩者之間的受控交換點
blocks.en: DMZ (demilitarized zone): a controlled exchange point between the two

blocks.zh: 無菌製藥CDMO的IT基礎設施架構
blocks.en: IT infrastructure architecture of a sterile pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: 若MES和ERP共用同一台資料庫伺服器，這個伺服器屬於GxP範圍嗎？你如何處理這個混合使用情況？
blocks.en: If MES and ERP share the same database server, is this server within GxP scope? How would you handle this mixed use?

blocks.zh: SCADA系統的網路路由器需要進行GAMP資格確認嗎？屬於哪個類別？
blocks.en: Does the network router of a SCADA system need GAMP qualification? Which category does it belong to?

blocks.zh: 一家CDMO的IT部門聲稱「雲端服務提供商的伺服器不在GxP範圍內，所以不需要資格確認」——你認為這種說法正確嗎？
blocks.en: An IT department at a CDMO claims that "the cloud service provider's servers are not within GxP scope, so no qualification is needed". Do you think this statement is correct?

blocks.zh: Regulatory Context | 法規背景比較
blocks.en: Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 vs EU Annex 11 — key requirements for IT Infrastructure · 美歐法規對IT基礎設施的要求比較
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 vs EU Annex 11: key requirements for IT Infrastructure

blocks.zh: 法規比較解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the regulatory comparison

blocks.zh: 兩大法規的核心差異
blocks.en: Core differences between the two regulations

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11：美國法規，重點在電子記錄和電子簽名的技術控制（以IT功能要求為主）
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11: A US regulation that focuses on technical controls for electronic records and electronic signatures (mainly IT functional requirements)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11：歐盟GMP附件，涵蓋整個電腦化系統生命週期，對IT基礎設施的明確要求更多
blocks.en: EU Annex 11: An EU GMP annex that covers the whole lifecycle of computerized systems and has more explicit requirements for IT infrastructure

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11 在2011年更新後，對供應商管理、雲端/外包、以及基礎設施資格確認都有更明確的規定，比Part 11更全面地涵蓋IT基礎設施。
blocks.en: After its 2011 revision, EU Annex 11 has clearer provisions on supplier management, cloud/outsourcing and infrastructure qualification, covering IT infrastructure more comprehensively than Part 11.

blocks.zh: CDMO合規策略：同時滿足兩套法規
blocks.en: CDMO compliance strategy: satisfying both regulations

blocks.zh: 服務美歐市場的CDMO必須同時符合兩套要求。實務上：
blocks.en: A CDMO serving both the US and EU markets must meet both sets of requirements. In practice:

blocks.zh: Audit trail：系統層級的時間戳記審計日誌（滿足Part 11 §11.10(e)和Annex 11第9條）
blocks.en: Audit trail: System-level, time-stamped audit logs (satisfies Part 11 §11.10(e) and Annex 11 clause 9)

blocks.zh: Backup & restore：定期備份並驗證還原能力（滿足Annex 11第7.2條）
blocks.en: Backup & restore: Regular backups with verified restore capability (satisfies Annex 11 clause 7.2)

blocks.zh: Access control：角色型存取控制，最小權限原則（滿足兩者）
blocks.en: Access control: Role-based access control with the principle of least privilege (satisfies both)

blocks.zh: Change control SOP：涵蓋IT基礎設施變更（滿足Annex 11第10條）
blocks.en: Change control SOP: Covers IT infrastructure changes (satisfies Annex 11 clause 10)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11 第4.7條的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of EU Annex 11 clause 4.7

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11明確要求「IT基礎設施資格確認」，是法規史上少數直接點名IT基礎設施（而非只談應用程式）需要資格確認的法規條文。這直接呼應本GAMP指南的核心主張。
blocks.en: EU Annex 11 explicitly requires "IT infrastructure qualification". It is one of the few regulatory provisions in history to name IT infrastructure (rather than only applications) as needing qualification. This directly echoes the core position of this GAMP guide.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 vs Annex 11 適用情境
blocks.en: Applicable scenarios: 21 CFR Part 11 vs Annex 11

blocks.zh: FDA PAI（上市前稽查）：重點查Part 11合規
blocks.en: FDA PAI (pre-approval inspection): focus on Part 11 compliance

blocks.zh: EMA GMP稽查：重點查Annex 11合規
blocks.en: EMA GMP inspection: focus on Annex 11 compliance

blocks.zh: PICS稽查（日本PMDA、澳洲TGA等）：通常遵循Annex 11框架
blocks.en: PIC/S inspections (Japan PMDA, Australia TGA, etc.): usually follow the Annex 11 framework

blocks.zh: 雙重申報（美歐）：兩套要求都需滿足
blocks.en: Dual filing (US and EU): both sets of requirements must be met

blocks.zh: 若你的DCS系統只向FDA申報（不申報歐盟），你是否還需要滿足EU Annex 11的要求？
blocks.en: If your DCS system is filed only with the FDA (not in the EU), do you still need to meet the requirements of EU Annex 11?

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11第11.10(e)的「電腦生成時間戳記審計日誌」——時間同步（NTP伺服器）是IT基礎設施還是應用程式的責任？
blocks.en: For the "computer-generated time-stamped audit trail" of 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e), is time synchronization (NTP server) the responsibility of IT infrastructure or of the application?

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11明確提到「外包服務」，若你的LIMS資料庫外包給第三方雲端，供應商協議需要包含哪些GxP要求？
blocks.en: EU Annex 11 explicitly mentions "outsourced services". If your LIMS database is outsourced to a third-party cloud, what GxP requirements must the supplier agreement include?

blocks.zh: Chapter 2 — Platforms | 第2章：平台
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Platforms

blocks.zh: Platform components and GAMP categories · 平台元件與GAMP類別分配
blocks.en: Platform components and GAMP category assignment

blocks.zh: GAMP類別速查（IT基礎設施版）
blocks.en: GAMP category quick reference (IT infrastructure edition)

blocks.zh: IT基礎設施平台主要落在 HW Cat 1, SW Cat 1-2；應用程式為 SW Cat 3-5。
blocks.en: IT infrastructure platforms mainly fall into HW Cat 1 and SW Cat 1-2; applications are SW Cat 3-5.

blocks.zh: 為何大多數IT基礎設施是Cat 1？
blocks.en: Why is most IT infrastructure Cat 1?

blocks.zh: Cat 1（基礎設施軟體）的假設是：這類軟體由大廠商（Microsoft、Cisco、VMware）廣泛測試和部署，行業已積累大量使用經驗，自我錯誤偵測能力強。因此，只需確認安裝正確、配置符合規格，不需要像應用程式一樣進行完整的業務功能測試。
blocks.en: The assumption for Cat 1 (infrastructure software) is that this type of software is widely tested and deployed by major vendors (Microsoft, Cisco, VMware), the industry has accumulated extensive experience with it, and it has strong self-error-detection capability. Therefore, you only need to confirm that it is installed correctly and configured to specification; full business-function testing as for applications is not required.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：韌體的特殊處理
blocks.en: Practical reminder: special handling of firmware

blocks.zh: 韌體（Firmware）通常被視為硬體的一部分。但當韌體可以獨立更新時（如伺服器BIOS/UEFI、網路設備韌體），就需要像軟體一樣管理：
blocks.en: Firmware is usually regarded as part of the hardware. But when firmware can be updated independently (such as server BIOS/UEFI or network device firmware), it needs to be managed like software:

blocks.zh: 納入變更管理流程
blocks.en: Include it in the change management process

blocks.zh: 分類為SW Category 2
blocks.en: Classify it as SW Category 2

blocks.zh: 記錄版本和更新紀錄
blocks.en: Record versions and update history

blocks.zh: 在GxP環境中，韌體更新需要評估對上層GxP應用程式的潛在影響。
blocks.en: In a GxP environment, firmware updates require an assessment of their potential impact on the GxP applications above them.

blocks.zh: 你廠區的Cisco防火牆屬於哪個GAMP類別？其配置文件需要如何管理？
blocks.en: Which GAMP category does the Cisco firewall at your site belong to? How should its configuration files be managed?

blocks.zh: 若VMware vSphere被用作GxP應用程式的虛擬化層，它應被分類為哪個GAMP類別？資格確認策略是什麼？
blocks.en: If VMware vSphere is used as the virtualization layer for GxP applications, which GAMP category should it be classified as? What is the qualification strategy?

blocks.zh: 「thin client vs thick client」的選擇對GxP合規有哪些影響？本地儲存的資料如何管理？
blocks.en: What are the GxP compliance implications of choosing a thin client vs a thick client? How is data stored locally managed?

blocks.zh: Processes | 流程
blocks.en: Processes

blocks.zh: ITIL-based IT Infrastructure processes for GxP compliance · 基於ITIL的IT基礎設施流程
blocks.en: ITIL-based IT Infrastructure processes for GxP compliance

blocks.zh: ITIL框架與GxP的整合
blocks.en: Integrating the ITIL framework with GxP

blocks.zh: ITIL（IT基礎設施資源庫）是全球IT服務管理的最佳實踐框架。許多IT部門已遵循ITIL，而GAMP指南承認ITIL的有效性，意味著：
blocks.en: ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) is a globally recognized best-practice framework for IT service management. Many IT departments already follow ITIL, and the GAMP guide's recognition of ITIL's effectiveness means:

blocks.zh: 若你的IT部門已實施ITIL：大部分流程框架可直接用於GxP合規，只需在現有流程上增加GxP相關要求（如更嚴格的文件記錄和QA審查）。
blocks.en: If your IT department has already implemented ITIL: Most of the process framework can be used directly for GxP compliance; you only need to add GxP requirements (such as stricter documentation and QA review) to the existing processes.

blocks.zh: 若尚未實施ITIL：可以從GxP要求最高的流程開始建立，再逐步完善。
blocks.en: If ITIL has not yet been implemented: You can start by building the processes with the highest GxP requirements and then refine them step by step.

blocks.zh: Change Management的特殊GxP挑戰
blocks.en: Special GxP challenges in Change Management

blocks.zh: 在GxP環境中，IT的「變更管理」比一般企業複雜：每一次OS patch、網路設備韌體更新、伺服器配置調整都需要評估是否影響已驗證的應用程式。這需要IT和QA緊密協作，而不是IT單獨決定。
blocks.en: In a GxP environment, IT "change management" is more complex than in a general enterprise: every OS patch, network device firmware update and server configuration adjustment must be assessed for impact on validated applications. This requires close collaboration between IT and QA, not decisions made by IT alone.

blocks.zh: 你廠區目前有哪些ITIL流程已實施？哪些尚未建立但GxP上是必要的？
blocks.en: Which ITIL processes are currently implemented at your site? Which are not yet established but are necessary for GxP?

blocks.zh: 「Configuration Management（組態管理）」在GxP環境中的「組態漂移（configuration drift）」是什麼意思？如何預防？
blocks.en: What does "configuration drift" mean for "Configuration Management" in a GxP environment? How can it be prevented?

blocks.zh: 若廠區的IT Help Desk是外包的，如何確保Help Desk記錄的問題和解決方案符合GxP的文件追溯要求？
blocks.en: If the IT Help Desk at your site is outsourced, how do you ensure that the problems and solutions recorded by the Help Desk meet GxP documentation and traceability requirements?

blocks.zh: Personnel | 人員
blocks.en: Personnel

blocks.zh: Roles, responsibilities, training, and qualifications · 角色、責任、訓練與資格
blocks.en: Roles, responsibilities, training, and qualifications

blocks.zh: IT人員的GxP訓練要求
blocks.en: GxP training requirements for IT personnel

blocks.zh: IT人員通常具備技術背景但缺乏GxP法規意識。必要的訓練項目包括：
blocks.en: IT personnel usually have a technical background but lack awareness of GxP regulations. Necessary training topics include:

blocks.zh: 法規認知：21 CFR Part 11、EU Annex 11的基本要求
blocks.en: Regulatory awareness: Basic requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11

blocks.zh: 流程訓練：GxP變更管理SOP、偏差處理程序
blocks.en: Process training: GxP change management SOP and deviation handling procedure

blocks.zh: 文件要求：ALCOA+原則（可歸屬、清晰、同步、原始、正確、完整、一致、持久、可用）
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: ALCOA+ principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available)

blocks.zh: 資格確認：IQ/OQ文件撰寫和執行
blocks.en: Qualification: Writing and executing IQ/OQ documents

blocks.zh: 「獨立QA」的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of "independent QA"

blocks.zh: 指南特別強調「independent QA in relation to information technology」——QA對IT活動的審查必須是獨立的，不能由IT部門自己審查自己的資格確認文件。
blocks.en: The guide specifically emphasizes "independent QA in relation to information technology": QA review of IT activities must be independent, and the IT department cannot review its own qualification documents.

blocks.zh: 在小型CDMO中，QA可能沒有IT專業背景，這時可考慮：
blocks.en: In a small CDMO, QA may not have an IT background. In this case, consider:

blocks.zh: 聘請兼具IT和GxP背景的IT Quality Compliance專員
blocks.en: Hiring an IT Quality Compliance specialist with both IT and GxP backgrounds

blocks.zh: 外部顧問提供獨立審查
blocks.en: Engaging an external consultant to provide independent review

blocks.zh: 建立交叉審查機制
blocks.en: Establishing a cross-review mechanism

blocks.zh: Application Owner vs Data Owner：不一定是同一人
blocks.en: Application Owner vs Data Owner: not necessarily the same person

blocks.zh: 指南明確區分兩個角色：
blocks.en: The guide clearly distinguishes between two roles:

blocks.zh: Application Owner：對LIMS系統（軟體）負責的人，通常是Lab Manager
blocks.en: Application Owner: The person responsible for the LIMS system (software), usually the Lab Manager

blocks.zh: Data Owner：對特定資料集負責的人，例如品保副總可能是「批次放行資料」的Owner，即使她不擁有LIMS系統
blocks.en: Data Owner: The person responsible for a specific data set. For example, the VP of Quality Assurance may be the Owner of "batch release data" even though she does not own the LIMS system

blocks.zh: 在GxP數據完整性調查中，釐清誰是Data Owner非常重要。
blocks.en: In a GxP data integrity investigation, it is very important to clarify who the Data Owner is.

blocks.zh: 你廠區是否有明確定義的「IT Quality and Compliance」角色？這個角色在組織架構中向誰匯報最合適？
blocks.en: Does your site have a clearly defined "IT Quality and Compliance" role? To whom is it most appropriate for this role to report in the organization?

blocks.zh: 若IT系統管理員執行了一個未記錄的伺服器配置變更，這在GxP稽查中會引發哪些問題？如何從人員/流程角度預防？
blocks.en: If an IT system administrator makes an undocumented server configuration change, what issues would this raise in a GxP inspection? How can it be prevented from a personnel/process perspective?

blocks.zh: 「訓練記錄應被維護」——你廠區的IT人員訓練記錄是在哪個系統中管理的？這個系統本身是否也需要GxP合規？
blocks.en: "Training records should be maintained" - in which system are the training records of IT personnel at your site managed? Does that system itself also need to be GxP compliant?

blocks.zh: Chapter 1–2 Summary | 第1–2章總結
blocks.en: Chapter 1–2 Summary

blocks.zh: Key takeaways and self-assessment · 重點整理與自我評估
blocks.en: Key takeaways and self-assessment

blocks.zh: 核心重點整理
blocks.en: Key takeaways

blocks.zh: Ch 1–2 的五條核心訊息
blocks.en: Five core messages of Chapters 1–2

blocks.zh: IT基礎設施是GxP系統的地基：地基失控，上面的應用程式驗證就失效。
blocks.en: IT infrastructure is the foundation of GxP systems: If the foundation is out of control, the validation of the applications above it is invalidated.

blocks.zh: 水平方法是核心策略：一次資格確認平台，多個應用程式受益，避免重複工作。
blocks.en: The horizontal approach is the core strategy: Qualify the platform once and multiple applications benefit, avoiding duplicated work.

blocks.zh: 三元素缺一不可：平台資格確認了、但沒有受過訓練的人員和文件化流程，合規依然不完整。
blocks.en: All three elements are indispensable: Even if the platform is qualified, compliance is still incomplete without trained personnel and documented processes.

blocks.zh: 風險驅動，規模可調：小公司不需要和大型跨國藥廠做同樣深度的資格確認，但框架邏輯相同。
blocks.en: Risk-driven and scaleable: A small company does not need the same depth of qualification as a large multinational manufacturer, but the framework logic is the same.

blocks.zh: IT和QA必須協同：沒有獨立的QA監督，IT基礎設施的GxP合規就是空架子。
blocks.en: IT and QA must work together: Without independent QA oversight, GxP compliance of IT infrastructure is an empty shell.

blocks.zh: 最終自我評估 — 你準備好了嗎？
blocks.en: Final self-assessment: are you ready?

blocks.zh: 你能向FDA稽查員解釋為什麼你們採用水平（而非垂直）的IT資格確認方法嗎？
blocks.en: Can you explain to an FDA inspector why you take a horizontal (rather than vertical) approach to IT qualification?

blocks.zh: 你的廠區能立即提供所有GxP伺服器的IQ/OQ文件嗎？
blocks.en: Can your site immediately provide the IQ/OQ documentation for all GxP servers?

blocks.zh: 你能說出每個GxP應用程式的Application Owner和Data Owner分別是誰嗎？
blocks.en: Can you name the Application Owner and Data Owner of each GxP application?

blocks.zh: 若明天伺服器發生故障，你能在RTO（恢復時間目標）內恢復GxP系統並提供完整的事件記錄嗎？
blocks.en: If a server fails tomorrow, can you restore the GxP systems within the RTO (recovery time objective) and provide a complete incident record?

blocks.zh: 你的IT人員上次接受GxP相關訓練是什麼時候？訓練記錄在哪裡？
blocks.en: When did your IT staff last receive GxP-related training? Where are the training records?
